personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, tactical command center optimized for rapid decision-making behind the wheel.

spacing.rule: Avoid tight clustering. Ensure minimum 48pt height for all touchable rows. Use md/lg spacing between modules to keep glanceability high.

dont's: Do not use glass or blur effects on any screen. Use solid surface overlays for clarity and performance.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: A sequential flow capturing preferences and permissions before launching into the app.

states.error: Failed to save preferences, retry button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Content at the bottom: Large title, clear description, and full-width bottom CTA pinned safely above home indicator.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Main monitoring view showing status and the most recent evaluated offer.

states.loading: Skeleton loading of the offer card
states.empty: Empty state illustration of a dark map/road, saying 'Monitoring active. Waiting for offers...'

screens.layout: Header shows monitoring toggle (Big, distinct state). Below it, today's stats (Earnings, Rides) in compact metric boxes. The center holds the 'Last Offer Card'—massive display of FARE, $/MILE, DISTANCE, structured as a modular card. Color-coded result tag (MATCH/REVIEW/NO MATCH) pinned prominently.

screens.name: OfferResult
screens.purpose: Full screen overlay detailing why a specific ride matched or failed.
screens.layout: Massive MATCH/NO MATCH/REVIEW header utilizing the respective success/error/warning colors. Giant metrics for Fare and $/Mile. A checklist below showing rules passed (green check) or failed (red cross). Sticky bottom CTA to 'Dismiss' or 'View Rules'.

screens.name: Preferences
screens.purpose: A form-heavy screen where the driver configures their rule engine.
screens.layout: Segmented by categories: Earnings, Distance, Areas. Inputs are large and touch-friendly. Use tonal chips for Areas. Sticky Save CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Demo
screens.purpose: Test the rules engine against pre-defined or manual mock offers.
screens.layout: List of 10+ predefined test offers using surfaceSecondary cards. Tapping one instantly slides up a bottom sheet with the OfferResult evaluation.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: A chronological log of all parsed offers and their match outcomes.
screens.layout: A flush list view. Each row uses a dense but readable layout: Left side shows platform icon (U/L) and time. Center shows Fare and Route. Right edge has a thick 4px border color-coded (Green/Yellow/Red) indicating the match status.

onboarding_hero.alt: Empty night road illuminated by streetlights

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'Dark-First Utility DARK' personality. Do not inject blues, purples, or playful elements.
BANNED: All blues including navy, purple, indigo, violet. Use the defined #F97316 (Orange) and utility greens/reds.
Metrics must dominate. Use Barlow Condensed for all numbers (Fare, Distance, Score) and push sizes large (2xl to 4xl equivalent) for readability at arm's length.
Strict color coding: MATCH uses #22C55E (success), NO MATCH uses #EF4444 (error), REVIEW uses #EAB308 (warning). Use these exact tokens for status backgrounds and text.
Ensure touch targets are universally 48pt minimum. Forms (like the Preferences tab) should use stackable modular rows, not floating inline text boxes.
Do NOT use glassmorphism. This is a high-visibility utility. Rely on solid 'surfaceSecondary' cards and 1pt borders for depth.

For logos (Uber/Lyft), as clean transparent PNGs were not found, use a fallback: A solid black circle with white 'UBER' text (Inter/IBM font, weight 500) and a solid pink circle (#FF00BF) with white 'LYFT' text.
Bottom CTA layout: Ensure the primary action is fixed above the safe area bottom in a separate solid view so content scrolls underneath.
